items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he commissioned me to write an album of big-band music and was going to record it.

ctx.x: I just want to briefly return to The Fabulous Bill Holman, the title of that album. I can‟t imagine that that was something that you chose, but perhaps you can set the record straight on that.

I don‟t know where – Shelly Manne was the producer on that, because a well known guy that had worked for Decca had called him and asked him to produce four jazz albums in L.A. We have to go back a little further, to a guy named Red Clyde, who was doing a lot of recording out here. I can‟t think of the name of the label, but he commissioned me to write an album of big-band music and was going to record it. So I got all the charts done, and I called Red and said, “Okay, Red. We‟re ready to go.” He said, “We‟re…
But you were happy with the music?
